note: Both sets suffer from severe redundancy, extracting the same facts multiple times with slight variations in entity or attribute names (e.g., Set B extracts the rated torque four times, Set A extracts the proportionality constant four times). Set A is slightly better because Set B contains a factual error (identifying 871 rpm as the lower bound for Region 1½ when it is the upper bound) and a misquote in its speed range claim.
